name: linux-crlf-message-block-parse
description: GitHub normalizes stored comment bodies to CRLF; the parser and `poll --full` must handle a CRLF-terminated body and a msg value containing escaped CRLF without dropping the tail or leaking a stray carriage return. The mock's fixture-parse discussion returns a CRLF-bodied vihs-collab-msg@v1 whose msg is a multi-line block; poll --full must render every line including the final tail (the ToFull 'never drops the tail' contract).
